## LLBox WhatsApp Chatbot + ChatGPT

Callback: `https://n8n.x-360.ai/webhook/llbox-whatsapp`
Verify token: `llbox-whatsapp-verify`

1. Config → paste OpenAI API key in `openaiApiKey`
2. Keep WhatsApp token + Phone Number ID
3. Activate workflow

Chat replies use **ChatGPT (gpt-4o-mini)**.
OTP / register / find locker still use **LLBox APIs**.
Voice calls stay on **ElevenLabs**.
If OpenAI key is missing, it falls back to simple rules.
